description: Open an extension surface or a url, or replay the toolbar action or a shortcut, over the control channel (by hand: --allow-control). A url opens in a background tab and answers target.targetId for extension_screenshot and the readers. A replay carries no user gesture.

asTab.description: Render the surface in a tab.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

foreground.description: Raise the tab; only for a page the person must act on.

newTab.description: New tab even if one shows the url.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

surface.description: Surface to open; action and command replay; devtools is Chromium only.

tab.description: With url: navigate this chrome.tabs id (not a tab position; from dom_snapshot listTabs: true).

url.description: Url to open (a path resolves to the extension).

name: extension_open
